title: Kavya Enterprises and its imported dry fruits
body: Kavya Enterprises imports 500 cartons of dry fruits from abroad. When the consignment arrives at the port, Kavya is not in a position to pay the full customs duty at once, and she does not need all the cartons immediately. The customs authorities therefore keep the goods in a warehouse licensed by the government to accept imported goods before payment of customs duty. Kavya brings her buyers to the warehouse to inspect the dry fruits and has some cartons repacked into smaller packs to suit their requirements. Each month she removes only the cartons she can sell and pays the import duty on them. Later, a buyer in Sri Lanka orders 100 cartons, and she ships them directly from the warehouse without paying Indian customs duty on them.
